split_policy: Reuse exact original case/group split; validation/test never fitted; count each canonical row once. No changed descriptions or labels.
selection_policy: Single preselected C16 reproduction; no hyperparameter or threshold tuning.
gates: Validation Critical recall and macro-F1 must not regress relative to v1.
Diagnostic test raw per-language accuracy must remain at least 85%; raw overall and combined routed accuracy must not regress relative to v1.
Combined high-risk underclassification count must not exceed previous 0/101.
Artifact integrity, text API contract, local Laravel-to-AI connection and public AI readiness must pass.
limitations: Historical source and diagnostic test already exposed; not fresh independent validation.
Synthetic labels and historical approved fields not independently verified; no approvals invented.
The counted word pack is a subset, not added training data. No promised accuracy improvement.
Every final operational severity requires admin confirmation; rule suggestions stay unscored.
